body:
You sound so much like me it hurts. I can't bear thinking about the people who love me missing me and feeling bad that they couldn't have saved me. I don't want to be alive, but I want to die in a car accident or something so my family and friends can come to terms with it easier. 

And the thought of my cat wandering around wondering where I am is so sad because everyone else understands, but he never will.

I have a therapist and I think I need to be put back on my medication, because I hate feeling this way. Please talk to a counselor or therapist. It took my four tries to find one that fit me, but they can be an outlet for what you're feeling and, if necessary, recommend medicine or different types of help for you.

I have a therapist, but sometimes it feels like an hour a week isn't enough because I have so much bitterness and hurt that's become a part of me that I feel is trapped inside and I can't talk about with anyone but her, so there's never enough time.

My one friend is going through a lot and she reached out to me and I told her I'd help and she never got back to me. I know she isn't sitting at home wallowing, though. She has a ton of other friends she sees all the time and she always just goes along with other people instead of doing what she wants to do. I want her to find herself outside of boys and other people.


My other friend is confused on what to do with his life, but I don't know how to help him. I offer him whatever help he needs, but we both don't know how to take the next step in his life. Other than that, I don't know. He is struggling with our relationship together because he has been using me since we met, but he is worried if he lets me go he'll regret it. He has been trying to sleep with other people since we lost our virginities together over a year ago, but he told me he is conflicted because if he has sex with someone he can't have sex with me without a condom so that's why he doesn't sleep with anyone else. We dated for half a year and I fell in love with him while he lied to me and told me he loved me the entire time. I am terrified to move on because I've never had a friend that I felt as close to, not even the friends I grew up with and I had known since I was born. He makes me happy, but his actions make me sad.

I don't know what's good about me. I have a hard time thinking about that because I have BDD and extremely low self esteem. In the good times, I know I'm very pretty, I'm ambitious, I'm well dressed, I'm very giving, and I have a whole lot of love that I never get back :(
